inputs.prompt: A concept artist sketchbook page of prop exploration for a dark fantasy video game: twelve rough concept sketches of the huge bed of an enormous alien that is always asleep, a sleeping throne with his talent tree growing out of it, laid out in a grid of four columns and three rows on white paper, each sketch numbered with a big hand written number from 1 to 12. Loose confident pencil lines with grey marker shading and a quick wash of pearl white with lilac shadows, plum and rose gold, with small glowing fruit. Every sketch shows the whole object in a three quarter view standing on bare sand, each a genuinely different idea, all made by one alien civilisation from pearly opalescent scaled shell, plum cloth printed with a starfield, rose gold trims and dark gunmetal with glowing orange glyph seams. Every one shows a tree of talents growing from the bed, its fruit glowing. Not a bathtub. The twelve ideas: 1 a giant pearly clam shell bed with a rose gold tree growing from its hinge, glowing fruit hanging over the sleeper. 2 a floating crescent moon bed of shell with plum starfield drapes and a tree of light behind it. 3 a mountain of plum starfield cushions with a coral tree growing out of the top. 4 a nest of pearly scales with crystal branches rising from its rim. 5 a low throne bed on four short feet with a bonsai tree of rose gold wire on its headboard. 6 a hovering platform whose tree roots wrap around it and whose fruit hangs over the mouth of the sleeper. 7 a hammock cocoon slung between two branches, the tree itself is the bed frame. 8 a halved giant pearl like an open oyster with a tree of small glowing pearls growing from it. 9 a long chaise of rose gold with the tree drawn in lines of light above it. 10 a bed carried on four floating orbs with a fountain of light branches feeding into it. 11 a bed sunk into a ring of shell plates like petals, the tree rising from the middle. 12 a stack of shell slabs like a layered cake with vines of glyph leaves climbing it. Short hand written notes and arrows beside some sketches. Clean white paper, no frame, no other text.
